analysis: K=10 rank-deficient covariance in 30D action space
conclusion: With K=10 and D=30, sample covariance is always rank-deficient (rank <= 9). 21 of 30 dimensions have zero estimated variance. Per-DOF conformal scores become degenerate: the model cannot distinguish noisy from reliable dimensions. This explains why crm_perdof degrades with higher epsilon while crm_obs_only remains robust.
paper_implication: Section 3.5: K=10 samples in 30D space yields rank-9 covariance. 21 eigenvalues are exactly zero, making per-DOF uncertainty estimates uninformative. obs_only mode avoids this by using scalar uncertainty (aggregated across all DOFs), which is well-estimated even at K=10.
